title: A Star Among Us
narration: Every morning, a silent giant rises. It holds 99.86% of everything in our solar system. Yet we barely notice it.
visual_goal: Sun rising over a landscape, with a subtle overlay of the solar system showing the sun's dominance

title: The Furnace Within
narration: At its core, 15 million degrees Celsius. Every second, 600 million tons of hydrogen become helium. That fire has burned for 4.6 billion years.
visual_goal: Cross-section animation of the sun's core, with fusion particles and energy radiating outward

title: The Journey Out
narration: Its surface simmers at 5,500 degrees. Above, the corona flares to a million. A magnetic pulse flips every 11 years.
visual_goal: Solar surface with prominences and corona, then a visualization of magnetic field lines flipping

title: Our Messenger
narration: We dared to touch it. The Parker Solar Probe came within 6.1 million kilometers of that fire—closer than anything we've ever sent.
visual_goal: Animation of Parker Solar Probe approaching the sun, with heat shield glowing, then a cut to the actual probe

title: The Long Goodbye
narration: It will shine for 5 billion more years. But one day, it will swell and fade. Until then, every sunrise is a gift.
visual_goal: Sequence: current sun, then red giant phase, then white dwarf, fading to a calm dawn on Earth
